refnamediv.refpurpose: Register a URL wrapper implemented as a PHP class

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
protocol
The wrapper name to be registered. Valid protocol names must contain alphanumerics, dots (.), plusses (+), or hyphens (-) only.
The name is case-sensitive: a wrapper registered as MyWrap is only reached through MyWrap://, and HTTP can be registered even though http already exists. A name of one character, or an empty name, can be registered but is never reached, since a scheme needs at least two characters to be recognized.
class
The classname which implements the protocol.
The class is autoloaded at registration time, but is not otherwise validated: an interface, a trait or an abstract class is accepted, and opening a stream then fails. A new instance is created for each operation, not only when a stream is opened. If the class declares a typed $context property, a TypeError is thrown when a stream is opened, since the property receives a resource.
flags
Should be set to STREAM_IS_URL if protocol is a URL protocol. Default is 0, local stream.
A wrapper registered with STREAM_IS_URL is subject to allow_url_fopen (for fopen, file_get_contents and file_exists) and to allow_url_include (for include), and stream_is_local returns &false; for it. Only the lowest bit of flags is used: other values are accepted and otherwise ignored.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a TypeError if class is not a valid class name. An exception thrown by an autoloader while the class is loaded is propagated.
